utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll send the latest repair drive update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’m keeping an eye out for the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring my tools by and see where I can help once they say what needs the most help first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’ll be listening for whatever they say needs help most, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring my tools by and wait to hear what needs the most help first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’m ready to help once Opal confirms, so just send the location when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—I'll send the location over as soon as Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll be ready as soon as Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ve got Maple Street as the first stop, and I’ll keep tracking the rest as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Opal. Just note the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Sunday at the community center is noted, and I’ll keep track of the rest of the stops as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s on — feel free to tell folks. I’ll keep you posted on who reaches out and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—you’re definitely keeping track of who signs up and what they can bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’ve got it covered — I’ll keep track and let you know who’s signing up and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll grab the duct tape, Phillips screwdriver, and spare screws if I can. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, glad that covers it — I’ll let you know if I come across anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out—hands, tools, and any spare supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’s a huge help. If you hear of anyone who can pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll send anyone willing to help your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. Start by sorting the donations by size, then we’ll load the last boxes by the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the donations by size and then help load the last boxes by the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help — I’ll swing by a bit late and check on the supplies when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep the supplies ready for when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I’ll send the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — you’ll send the details soon, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh right — Sunday at the community center now, got it, Uli. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it quiet—just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Uli — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check the drill battery tonight and let you know. We’ll wait on the tools until we know the time and what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please check the battery tonight, and let me know the time and any missing supplies when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll check the battery tonight and get back to you with the time and any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:30 Saturday should work after the school run. Thanks, Gus — the drill and screwdrivers will be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — 9:30 Saturday it is. I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers and see you then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you Saturday at 9:30 after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — Sunday at the community center around 9 works great. I’ll let folks know the update and keep everything moving along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll watch for the schedule and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send the schedule over and keep it right after pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — please send the timing and the list when you can so I can plan what I’m able to cover.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll send over the timing and who’s bringing what, and I’ll bring my tools to the repair drive to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — that makes planning much easier. Once you send it, I’ll check what I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’m still waiting on Pia’s list, and I’ll send the latest tally as soon as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m putting the list together now and I’ll send the drop-off details soon. I just want to keep the logistics clear so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — that helps a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for the list and the drop-off details, then I’ll tally everything up right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday around 9 works for me, and I can help with quieter tasks. I can spare a basic screwdriver and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. Can you come by around 9 with the screwdriver and gloves, and let me know if you can handle any other quiet tasks?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can be there around 9 with the screwdriver and gloves. I can also help sort parts or hold things steady if that stays quiet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring my tools and check in Sunday at the community center. Just point me to the most urgent repair when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — the nearest roof leak is the top priority, and a broken window is right behind it. Please bring your ladder, tarp, tape, and a hammer if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring a ladder, tarp, tape, and a hammer on Sunday. I’ll head straight to the roof leak first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard you’re still short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a few spare screws, so I’ll keep an eye out for those. If I spot them, I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. Just bring them by if you find any.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll bring them by if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send it over when you can, and I’ll help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send over the latest details and sign-up list soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — once you send it, I’ll sort through the list and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey — I’ll pass along the full details soon, and I’m glad you can help on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Rey — I’ll send the details around soon, and I really appreciate you coming by to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along are we on the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure I’ve got the latest tally in front of me, Mina, but I’ll check and get it to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the biggest needs right now are the front steps, a leaky faucet, and a few loose porch boards. I’ll get the updated Sunday community center details out so volunteers know where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Rosa — I’ll help line up volunteers for the front steps, the faucet, and the porch boards so we’re ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll send out the Sunday community center update and your volunteer list so everyone has the right info. Thanks for helping keep this organized!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the exact time, but we definitely need hands and a few spare tools and supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please let me know as soon as you get the time, and I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or supplies we still need.
